messages:
alex (docs): Hi all — opened a docs PR to add Lumen5B to the model catalog and quickstart. Need final perf numbers, a short compatibility note for the q4 quant build, and SDK v3 streaming migration text. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7421 :wave:

maria (ml): Microbench results: p50 ~12ms/token (fp16) at 512 seq on A100. Lumen5B-q4: ~9ms/token but latency increases past 2048 due to KV cache layout. Throughput (batch=8): fp16 ~140 tok/s, q4 ~180 tok/s.

sam (runtime): Runtime note: q4 uses a CPU-fallback for block attention sizes >2048 which causes the tail latency bump. Suggest compatibility blurb: "q4 validated to 2048 tokens. For 2048-4096 expect degraded latency and higher memory usage; prefer fp16 for >4096."

kofi (sdk): PR currently has old SDK v2 snippets. I'll replace them with SDK v3 runnable examples for generate and streaming. Proposed Python streaming snippet:

```
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
with client.generate_stream(model="lumen5b") as s:
    for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```

And a minimal JS embeddings example:

```
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const emb = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'lumen5b-embed', input: 'hello' })
console.log(emb.data[0].embedding.length)
```

alex (docs): Thanks, kofi — please confirm exact import paths and function names so snippets are copy-paste runnable. Also we need a one-line product-friendly blurb for the model card.

jen (product): Blurb idea: "Lumen5B — compact, low-latency 5B encoder-decoder optimized for chat and instruction tasks. Q4 quantized build available for lower-cost inference with tradeoffs on long contexts." Keep it short. :+1:

maria (ml): Add compatibility callouts to the card: "Quantized (q4) uses int8 kernels and is validated up to 2048 tokens. For workloads with frequent prefix caching or very long contexts prefer fp16. Quality regressions are small for prompts under 1024 tokens; validate your prompts before switching."

sam (runtime): Ops guidance: "For Dedicated/Private deployments, pin fp16 for SLOs requiring consistent latency above 2048 tokens; otherwise runtime will auto-fallback and may incur higher tail latency."

alex (docs): Reviewer checklist for the PR: - update model card front-matter (family, arch, tokenizer) - add limits table for fp16/q4 - include bench numbers + harness link - replace SDK v2 snippets with v3 examples - verify model weights link (initial PR had a 404) - add product blurb and security/data handling note

kofi (sdk): Confirming imports: JS default export from '@redwood/inference', Python `from redwood import Redwood`. generate_stream is the current API on the studio branch. I'll open a micro-PR to update snippets after this thread.

alex (docs): docs-bot flagged a broken weights link in CI: https://models.redwood.ai/lumen5b/v1/weights.tar.gz  (404). Maria, can you provide the canonical registry URL or alternate link?

maria (ml): Use the registry entry: https://models.redwood.ai/registry/lumen5b. Infra will push the direct weights tar to the public bucket; ETA ~24 hours. Bench harness link: https://bench.redwood.ai/runs/lumen5b/2026-03-20 (repro scripts included).

docs-bot: PR check failed — broken links detected. See CI logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/987654.

alex (docs): I'll update the PR to point to the registry and add a short note: "direct weights link will be added once available." Also adding a brief SDK migration note: "If migrating from SDK v2, replace old client.generate(...) streaming patterns with client.generate_stream(...) and update import paths." Any objections?

jen (product): Go ahead. Also add a Dedicated-customer callout: "Contact support to enable q4 kernels on your Dedicated pool for consistent q4 performance with long contexts."

sam (runtime): Suggest adding a minimal machine-readable limits snippet so infra/console can parse it, e.g.:

```
"limits": { "fp16_max_seq": "8192", "q4_max_seq": "2048" }
```

alex (docs): Good idea — will add that JSON and mark values as tested defaults. Kofi, ETA for snippets PR?

kofi (sdk): Pushing snippet update now, ETA ~30 minutes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7423

alex (docs): Updated the main PR with snippet swaps, limits JSON, product blurb, bench link, and compatibility notes. Waiting on infra for weight link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7421

maria (ml): Infra confirmed weights push is in progress. Will post here when the public link is live.

alex (docs): Marking this thread resolved for docs edits. Will re-open if the weights link doesn't land by EOD. Thanks all. :party:
